```{r}
# Setup for inline 3D plotting
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
library(rgl)
rgl::setupKnitr()
library(data.table)

base_folder <- "/Users/hyoyeon/Desktop/Career/Sony/simulation"
folder <- "2025_10_22_15_00"
data_dir <- file.path(base_folder, folder)

files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern="^SummaryIndividuals_\\d+\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)
```

```{r}
nums <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", basename(files)))
ord  <- order(nums)
files <- files[ord]
nums  <- nums[ord]

splits <- lapply(files, fread)
splits <- Filter(function(dt) nrow(dt) > 0, splits)
stopifnot(length(splits) > 0)

world <- rbindlist(splits, use.names=TRUE, fill=TRUE, idcol="src_id")
world[, file_index := nums[src_id]]
world[, src_id := NULL]

# sample
set.seed(42)
sample_size <- 10000
if (nrow(world) > sample_size) {
  world <- world[sample(.N, sample_size)]
}

open3d(useNULL = TRUE)

denom <- function(x){ m <- max(x, na.rm=TRUE); if(!is.finite(m) || m==0) 1 else m }
colors <- rgb(
  world$speed     / denom(world$speed),
  world$maxEnergy / denom(world$maxEnergy),
  world$kidEnergy / denom(world$kidEnergy)
)

```{r}
# Plot 3D tree
rgl.clear()
plot3d(
  x = world$created,
  y = world$pgmDeath,   # adjust if missing
  z = world$maxEnergy,
  col = colors,
  size = 3,
  alpha = 0.9,
  main = paste0(folder, " (sampled full tree)")
)

rglwidget()
```
